lines: @@ -13,6 +13,9 @@ versioned together, so those entries cover all of them.

+- `Strategy#redirect` no longer raises `Encoding::CompatibilityError` for a URI in an encoding that isn't ASCII-compatible, such as UTF-16 or UTF-32. The URI is transcoded to UTF-8 first, with invalid or unmappable characters replaced, so both the `:iframe` script and the 302 work.

- `Strategy#redirect` now escapes the target URI before interpolating it into the inline `<script>` emitted when the `:iframe` option is enabled. Previously the URI was written verbatim, so a value containing a quote, `</script>`, or a line terminator could break out of the JavaScript string literal and execute in the application's origin (CWE-116/79). The `:iframe` branch also only emits the script for an `http(s)` or relative/protocol-relative target; a `javascript:`, `data:`, or `vbscript:` URI (which escaping cannot neutralize) falls through to the ordinary 302, whose `Location` header is inert. The non-iframe branch now HTML-escapes the URI it writes into the 302 body, and both branches send a `text/html` Content-Type.

- `Strategy#store_origin` now refuses to persist an `omniauth.origin` (from the origin param or the referer) whose scheme can run as script (`javascript:`, `data:`, `vbscript:`), so any code that later redirects to the stored origin can't execute it. **Behavior change:** an origin param with one of those schemes, or one that isn't a String (such as `origin[]=...`), is dropped and no longer falls back to the referer. Other schemes, including non-web deep links such as `myapp://` used by mobile sign-in, are still stored.
+    # A URI in an encoding that isn't ASCII-compatible, such as UTF-16, can't
+    # be matched against the scheme checks or written into the UTF-8 response,
+    # so it's transcoded to UTF-8 first. Anything else is returned as-is.
# Re-raises errors from the downstream app; reports anything else
# raised during a phase as an authentication failure.
+    context 'when the URI is in an encoding that is not ASCII-compatible' do
+      it 'transcodes it for the inline :iframe script' do
+      it 'transcodes it for the 302 body and Location header' do
+      it 'transcodes a String subclass too' do
+      it 'replaces an invalid sequence, such as a lone surrogate, instead of failing the request' do
+      it 'replaces a character with no UTF-8 mapping instead of failing the request' do
+      it 'leaves the bytes of a binary URI in the Location header alone' do
